version.description: The policy version; 0 is the built-in default (nothing published).

crossRegionSurchargeCents.description: Added to the effective cost of a candidate whose node region differs from the delivery area region (both known). 0 = off.

maxCostDeviationPercent.description: The regional budget: among candidates whose effective cost is within cheapest + floor(cheapest * percent / 100), an in-region candidate beats a cross-region one. 0 = off.

publishedAt.description: When the version was published. Absent on version 0.
